# Simulation E2E Fixture

Every text file in this directory was written for this repository's automated
tests. It is synthetic and original; it is not copied, paraphrased, translated,
or derived from a user upload or a published work.

The corpus deliberately contains:

- a stable reveal/consequence technique repeated across body segments;
- an opening-only technique;
- two mutually contradictory stage techniques;
- one outlier segment;
- a preface/announcement that must not count as stable body evidence; and
- invented proper nouns and the rare phrase `琥珀潮汐折叠七枚纸月` for the
  project-local copy scanner.

Fixture IDs are test protocol markers. Keep them stable. Add new files or
markers in a focused review; never replace this directory from production data.
Golden expectations must be edited individually alongside an explanation of
the intended invariant change. There is intentionally no bulk golden-update
command.
